findings.detail: Per-child finally computes file_sha(log) without protection. If worker/timeout/guard error is active, secondary log read/hash error replaces its outward exception. Preserve original_error, record/note secondary failure; raise hash error only if no primary.

Outer finally exclusive result guard/serialization/open/write is unprotected. A secondary reporting failure replaces active worker/timeout/guard exception. Preserve primary with secondary record/note; standalone reporting error must still propagate.

static_checks.observer_outcomes: Exactly two module-local aliases delegate original read/replace once with unchanged arguments, return and primary error. Bookkeeping failures mark INVALID; restore checks still-owned aliases. No retry/deadline/lock/security bypass.
static_checks.native_error_scope: Original ctypes use_last_error operations capture native WinError inside original before observer finally. Observer preserves exception.winerror; no generic GetLastError/OS-query attribution is claimed.
static_checks.cost_scope: Inclusive wall/thread CPU and whole-self logical IO/cycles exclude children; direct partial overhead <1% is a screen only, not total perturbation or exclusive causation proof. No physical disk/hard-fault or historical cause claim.
